entry.title: New: Resolution 430 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 430-25 - 01/07/26
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE KOHALA CENTER, INC., TO ASSIST WITH EXPENSES FOR ITS “KEEPER OF THE BAY” COMMUNITY SCREENING AT KAHILU THEATRE

Transfers $3,000 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 9)
